options.name: Notice
options.description: Perform this check AFTER brick cleaning is finished, usually before handover.

nodes.name: Visual Appearance & Straightness
nodes.description: Sight down the wall from a corner. Is the wall straight (not wavy)? Is it clean (no messy mortar)? Are there any cracked or chipped bricks? Tip: A good wall looks flat like a sheet of paper. If it looks wavy or dirty at first glance, flag it.

nodes.name: Weep Holes & Flashing
nodes.description: Check bottom bricks and above windows. Are there vertical gaps (Weep Holes) every ~1m? Ensure holes are NOT blocked by mortar or soil. Can you see black flashing inside the hole? Tip: These are the house's "nostrils" for breathing and draining. Blocked holes will cause mold inside.

nodes.name: Expansion Gaps
nodes.description: Find the long vertical gap on long walls (>6m). CRITICAL: The gap must be filled with SOFT sealant/foam. It must NEVER be filled with hard mortar! Tip: This gap allows the wall to expand in heat. If filled with hard cement, the wall will crack.

nodes.name: Window Sill Gap
nodes.description: Check the space between the Window Frame and the Brick Sill below it. CRITICAL: There must be a clear gap (approx. 5-10mm). It must NOT be filled with mortar. Tip: The house frame shrinks over time. Without this gap, the window will crush against the bricks and break.
